description: Resolve organism, place, project, or observer names to identifiers. Taxon lookup matches word starts within a name, not only its beginning; other types use cross-kind search with limited spelling tolerance. Without page, candidates retain relevance order. Explicit taxon pages browse name matches in ascending taxon-ID order; this can differ from autocomplete matching across languages. A miss returns found false with recovery guidance.

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return, applied to every type. Ceiling: 30; oversized values are clamped.

page.description: Optional page for browsing beyond relevance-ranked suggestions. Taxon name pages use ascending taxon-ID order from page 1; numeric taxon IDs have only one page. Keep limit unchanged while paging. page × applied limit must not exceed 10,000.

q.description: The name to resolve. Taxon queries match word starts within a name or an exact numeric taxon id; other types match record text with limited spelling tolerance.

rank.description: Restrict taxon candidates to one rank. Honoured only on type "taxon" — the cross-kind search has no rank filter.

type.description: Which kind of record to resolve. "taxon" uses autocomplete unless an explicit page browses name matches in taxon-ID order; numeric taxon IDs always use autocomplete. Other types use scored cross-kind search, and "any" searches all kinds. For place geometry and containment, use inaturalist_find_places.

name: inaturalist_resolve_name

candidates.description: Candidates in relevance order, or ascending taxon-ID order on explicit taxon name pages.

display_name.description: Place name with its administrative context, on places.

id.description: The identifier to pass onward — taxon_id, place_id, project id, or user id.

kind.description: Which record kind this candidate is.

login.description: Observer login, on users only — the value inaturalist_get_leaderboard entries and an observation’s observer carry.

matched_term.description: The name variant that actually matched the query.

name.description: Scientific name on taxa, place name, project title, or an observer’s display name — which falls back to the login when the observer set none.

observations_count.description: How many observations the record covers.

photo.description: Representative photo, when the record carries one.

attribution.description: Verbatim attribution; reproduce with any use of the image.

license_code.description: Photo licence code. Null means all rights reserved, independent of the record.

medium_url.description: Medium image URL; derived from the size path if needed. Absent when no variant is available.

open.description: True when served from the open-licence host at fetch time; licences can change.

square_url.description: 75px square variant, exactly as upstream published it. Null when absent.

score.description: Relevance score, on the cross-kind search only. No fixed range — meaningful only relative to other candidates in this response, which are already sorted best match first.

slug.description: URL slug, on places and projects.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `result_window_exceeded`: An explicit page multiplied by the applied limit exceeds 10,000. `rank_not_applicable`: rank was supplied with a type other than taxon. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when candidates matched, including an empty explicit page past an existing match set.

guidance.description: Why nothing matched and what to try instead. Present only when found is false — this is the primary result of a miss.

notice.description: Composed clamp, continuation, or empty-page guidance.

shown.description: Number of candidates returned on this slice.

totalCount.description: Total candidates upstream matched, before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when further matching candidates remain beyond this slice.

title: Inaturalist Resolve Name
